title: Wedding Registry Allowance on a Finch Circle Card Floor
content:
**Rule.** For a card floor in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program, the floor bridal allowance is 20.00 when the customer has an active Wedding Registry whose event date falls 0 to 120 calendar days after the change date, 10.00 when it falls more than 120 and up to 365 days after, and 0.00 otherwise.

The registry is the customer's own Wedding Registry under Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry, in active status; its event date is compared with the change date of the card floor.

| Event date of the active Wedding Registry, counted from the change date | Floor bridal allowance (USD) |
|---|---|
| 0 to 120 calendar days after | 20.00 |
| 121 to 365 calendar days after | 10.00 |
| before the change date, more than 365 days after, or no active Wedding Registry | 0.00 |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Change date 1 March; wedding on 29 June, 120 days after: 20.00.
- Wedding on 30 June, 121 days after: 10.00.
- The customer's active registry is a Baby Registry, not a Wedding Registry: 0.00.
- The wedding date fell last month: 0.00.
